data.name: dism_sfc_chkdsk_Description
data.value: Repair the Windows image and system files, then scan the system drive for filesystem errors.

data.name: dism_sfc_chkdsk_CompletionNote

data.name: component_cleanup_Description

data.name: network_reset_Description
data.value: Flush DNS and reset Winsock and TCP/IP to repair persistent network problems.

data.name: network_reset_Confirmation

data.name: network_reset_CompletionNote

data.name: windows_update_reset_Description
data.value: Recreate the Windows Update download and catalog caches when updates are stuck.

data.name: windows_update_reset_Confirmation

data.name: empty_standby_list_Description
data.value: Use Microsoft RAMMap to empty cached standby memory only when diagnosing a measured memory problem.

data.name: empty_standby_list_Confirmation
data.value: Cached RAM is released automatically when applications need it. Emptying it routinely does not improve FPS or PC performance and can make games load more slowly. Continue only for a documented standby-list problem.

data.name: remove_windows_ai_Confirmation
data.value: This removes packages and disables features. It is partially irreversible and TweakHub cannot guarantee automatic reinstallation. Continue?
